Write a submission's screenshots and recordings to files

Source: R/submission.R
extract_submission_media.Rd

A pasted screenshot (question()'s allow_image) or a voice recording (allow_audio) sits in the downloaded file as a base64 data URL, which nothing opens directly. This writes each one to dir as <question id>.<ext> (.webp or .jpg for a screenshot, .webm for a recording), so a grader can look or listen. load_tutorial() is the alternative: it shows them in place, in the tutorial.

Usage

extract_submission_media(path, dir = NULL, quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

path

Path to a JSON file downloaded via download_answers_button().

dir

Directory to write into, created if needed. Defaults to a directory named after the file, beside it.

quiet

If FALSE, the default, say what was written.

Value

Invisibly, a character vector of the files written, named by question id. Empty when the file holds no media.

See also

check_submission().

Examples

answers <- tempfile(fileext = ".json")
writeLines(paste0(
  '{"answers": [{"id": "plot-1", "answer": "data:image/webp;base64,',
  jsonlite::base64_enc(charToRaw("not really an image")), '"}]}'
), answers)
files <- extract_submission_media(answers, dir = tempfile())
#> Wrote 1 file(s) to '/tmp/RtmpwmMymS/file1993746302d0': plot-1.webp
basename(files)
#> [1] "plot-1.webp"
